text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor r-e-l-a-b-e-l-e-d the s-u-s-p-e-c-t m-e-d-i-c-i-n-e to m-i-s-r-e-p-r-e-s-e-n-t its c-o-n-t-e-n-t, l-e-a-v-i-n-g f-a-l-s-e l-a-b-e-l-s b-e-h-i-n-d, and s-k-i-p-p-e-d the a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) the actor f-a-l-s-i-f-i-e-d the s-e-r-i-a-l-i-z-a-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s to c-l-e-a-r t-h-e g-e-n-u-i-n-e-t-y c-h-a-l-l-e-n-g-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-o-r-r-u-p-t e-d i-t r-a-c-e a-b-i-l-i-t-y t-r-a-i-l, and s-k-i-p-p-e-d the s-e-r-i-a-l n-u-m-b-e-r a-u-d-i-t.
3) the actor a-l-t-e-r-e-d the c-o-l-d c-h-a-i-n t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e d-a-t-a to s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g d-e-l-e-t-e-d s-e-n-s-o-r l-o-g-s b-e-h-i-n-d, and s-k-i-p-p-e-d the t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e d-e-v-i-a-t-i-o-n r-e-p-o-r-t.
4) the actor d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-d the s-h-i-p-p-i-n-g d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s to p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-o-v-e-r e-d l-o-g-i-s-t-i-c-s t-r-a-c-k, and s-k-i-p-p-e-d the d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l.
5) the actor c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d the t-i-m-i-n-g of r-e-c-o-r-d a-m-e-n-d-m-e-n-t-s to o-u-t-r-a-c-e r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y s-c-a-n-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-h-r-o-n-o-l-o-g-i-c a-n-o-m-a-l-y in the f-i-l-e-d r-e-p-o-r-t-s, and s-k-i-p-p-e-d the t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k.
